response.original_title: While They Pay With Their Lives
response.overview: A short film exploring the harsh realities of child labour within the fashion industry. The film highlights how children are exploited, working in unsafe conditions and sacrificing their childhoods to produce garments and accessories for minimal wages. Against the convenience of modern technology, where fashion is available at our fingertips and purchases can be made instantly, the film encourages viewers to pause and consider the hidden human cost behind fast fashion. It serves as a reminder to make more conscious purchasing decisions and question who truly pays the price for the clothes we wear.
